A fix (query, generator multiplier or engine settings) chosen by the owner and landed, with measured cell durations

context:
2026-11-12: BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4171 (644f19d27a) changed the TPC-DI scale unit to the specification's 5,000 customers. SF 1 now has 1,212,320 fact rows (130,000 trades, 120,300 cash, 120,470 holdings, 541,550 market history, 300,000 watches) with 5,000 customers, 800 securities and 500 companies, down from 6.77 million. Local DuckDB generate/load/power at SF 1 on that commit: 152 of 152 queries succeeded, run took 168 s wall, mean query 986 ms; the slow query was not identified. Spark and DataFusion were not re-run. Re-measure before restoring them to the release gate: the volume is still 4.4 times the pre-#4149 275,000 rows, and dimension cardinalities fell tenfold, which changes join fan-out.

2026-11-15 measurements on develop 3f8cf88f4a (macOS arm64, 16 GiB, shared host). Cause: data volume; at the specification's scale unit (#4171, 1.21M fact rows, 5,000 customers) both cells fit the 1200 s budget with no query or engine change. DataFusion `make uat-cell` SF 1: passed, 64.07 s, 152/152, slowest AQ2 4.4 s and AQ6 3.6 s; no AQ5 stall. Spark load+power with driver_memory=3g: 152/152, 451 s wall, slowest AQ5 53 s and AQ7 24 s. Spark `make uat-cell` with the default heap was stopped by the watchdog at 452 s: JVM 7.80 GiB against the 8 GiB local budget (tree 8.08 GiB), a local memory limit and not the cell timeout. The prunes are removed in a pull request; the third acceptance (both cells green in a trunk UAT) is checked after merge.

2026-11-15: the prune removal is open as BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4257 (reviewed SHIP, CI green except the release-v2 probe, which timed out twice because its dispatched Release v2 run stayed queued behind about 50 other runs). Claim released while that waits; after merge, confirm Spark and DataFusion tpcdi 1.0 green in a trunk UAT, then finish.
description: #4149 (25a271c1) made FactCashBalances, FactHoldings, FactMarketHistory and FactWatches scale linearly (SF1 facts went from 275k to 6.77M rows, matching benchmark_specs.yaml). In trunk UAT 43154678095, spark tpcdi 1.0 went from 311 s to the 1200 s timeout, datafusion tpcdi 1.0 from 62 s to two timeouts, clickhouse-local 1.0 from 33 s to 255 s, and spark 0.1 from 199 s to 411 s. The join-heavy analytic queries AQ2, AQ4-AQ7 and AQ10 take 11-21 s each locally on DataFusion, and one local run stalled more than 20 minutes on AQ5 in the second pass (undiagnosed, shared machine). Spark and DataFusion tpcdi 1.0 are compatibility-pruned in the release gate until this is fixed.
